overview_description.description:
Girnaas is a mobile game development studio that offers services for training, productivity, advertising, education, lifestyle, and health-related needs. It is also engaged in the development of mobile applications and websites.

Girnaas was founded on February 14, 2013, and is based in Doha, Qatar.
